title: Alternating Digit Sum
summary: Given a positive integer n, assign a positive sign to its most significant digit and alternate the sign for each subsequent digit.
statement: Given a positive integer n, assign a positive sign to its most significant digit and alternate the sign for each subsequent digit. Calculate the sum of these digits with their respective signs.
constraints: Read decimal digits from most significant to least significant.
Give the first digit a positive sign and alternate negative, positive, and so on.
hints: Convert n to its decimal string to preserve left-to-right order.
Use the digit index parity to choose its sign.
Add even-index digits and subtract odd-index digits.
Zero-based even positions are exactly the first, third, and later positive-sign positions.
editorial: Zero-based even positions are exactly the first, third, and later positive-sign positions.

tests.explanation: The signed digits are five minus two plus one, giving four.
One minus one plus one gives one.
